# Dataset class
class LeafDiseaseDataset(torch.utils.data.Dataset):
    def __init__(self, image_dir, df, transform=None):
        self.image_dir = image_dir
        self.df = df
        self.transform = transform
        self.image_ids = df["image_id"].tolist()

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.image_ids)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        # Ensure image extension matches expected format (.jpg)
        if not self.image_ids[idx].endswith("."):
            ext = ".jpg"
        else:
            ext = ""
        image_path = os.path.join(self.image_dir, f"{self.image_ids[idx]}{ext}")

        try:
            img = Image.open(image_path).convert("RGB")
        except FileNotFoundError:
            # Fallback for missing images during development/debugging
            img = Image.new("RGB", (224, 224), color=(128, 128, 128))

        if self.transform:
            img = self.transform(img)

        # Convert to tensor and normalize
        img_tensor = img.to_tensor().to(device)
        return img_tensor, idx


def load_data():
    # Load data files
    train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
    test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

    # Check image paths for both train and test
    # Based on Data Overview: Images in ./input/images/ match IDs in CSVs

    # Split training data strictly into train and validation to ensure hold-out
    val_ratio = 0.25
    n_train_rows = train_df.shape[0]
    n_val_rows = int(n_train_rows * val_ratio)
    n_final_train_rows = n_train_rows - n_val_rows

    # Using shuffle=False for reproducibility here, though random_state is safer
    np.random.seed(42)
    rng = np.random.RandomState(42)
    perm = np.random.permutation(n_train_rows)
    val_indices = perm[:n_val_rows]
    train_indices = perm[n_val_rows:]

    train_labels = train_df.iloc[train_indices].copy()
    val_labels = train_df.iloc[val_indices].copy()

    # Ensure all target columns are converted to float
    target_cols = ["healthy", "rust", "scab", "multiple_diseases"]
    for col in target_cols:
        train_labels[col] = train_labels[col].astype(float)
        val_labels[col] = val_labels[col].astype(float)

    # Reorder train_indices to continuous range 0..N-1 for consistent DataLoader index mapping if needed
    # But simpler: use indices directly or reorder dataframe
    # We want contiguous indices for simplicity in dataset creation logic without complex remapping
    shuffled_train_labels = train_labels.loc[list(train_indices)]
    shuffled_val_labels = val_labels.loc[list(val_indices)]

    # Reset indices
    shuffled_train_labels.index = range(shuffled_train_labels.shape[0])
    shuffled_val_labels.index = range(shuffled_val_labels.shape[0])

    # Prepare test dataframe
    test_df_processed = test_df.copy()
    test_df_processed = test_df_processed.sort_values("image_id").reset_index(drop=True)

    # Get paths
    # Note: Using sorted IDs helps ensure consistency
    combined_image_paths = []
    combined_image_ids = list(
        set(list(train_labels["image_id"]) + list(test_df["image_id"]))
    )

    return shuffled_train_labels, shuffled_val_labels, test_df_processed


def preprocess_transform(size=(224, 224)):
    transform = transforms.Compose(
        [
            transforms.Resize(size),
            transforms.ToTensor(),
            transforms.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
        ]
    )
    return transform


def main():
    start_time = time.time()
    print("Loading data...")

    combined_train, val_labels, test_df = load_data()

    # Define classes - order matters for consistent indexing
    class_names = ["healthy", "rust", "scab", "multiple_diseases"]
    n_classes = len(class_names)

    # Create datasets
    # Combine train labels to ensure they are indexed 0..len-1 for DataLoader batching
    # (Note: shuffling ensures data integrity but we need contiguous indices for batched processing if we rely on idx)
    # Actually, using shuffled labels is better than relying on dataframe row order
    train_dataset = LeafDiseaseDataset(
        "./input/images/", combined_train, preprocess_transform()
    )
    val_dataset = LeafDiseaseDataset(
        "./input/images/", val_labels, preprocess_transform()
    )
    # Test dataset
    test_dataset = LeafDiseaseDataset(
        "./input/images/", test_df, preprocess_transform()
    )

    # Suppress tqdm if any library uses it internally (set disabled=True or None hooks)
    # Already done globally above, but ensuring DataLoaders don't show progress unless desired
    # DataLoader doesn't show progress by default in some configs, but often tqdm is attached to iter

    train_loader = torch.utils.data.DataLoader(
        train_dataset, batch_size=32, shuffle=True, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
    )
    val_loader = torch.utils.data.DataLoader(
        val_dataset, batch_size=32, shuffle=False, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
    )
    test_loader = torch.utils.data.DataLoader(
        test_dataset, batch_size=32, shuffle=False, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
    )

    print("Building model...")
    # Load pretrained ResNet18 backbone
    resnet18 = models.resnet18(weights=models.ResNet18_Weights.DEFAULT)

    # Freeze early layers and build new head
    # Allowing full training could be slow or cause issues on low quality data
    # but keeping it simple
    # Unfreeze everything for a few more layers
    for param in resnet18.parameters():
        param.requires_grad = True

    # Modify the final layer to match number of classes
    resnet18.num_features = resnet18.fc.in_features
    resnet18.classifier[1] = nn.Linear(resnet18.classifier[1].in_features, n_classes)

    model = resnet18.to(device)

    # Training setup
    optimizer = optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.001, weight_decay=1e-4)
    criterion = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss(reduction="none")

    # Train for multiple epochs
    num_epochs = 15
    best_val_loss = float("inf")
    best_model_state = None
    best_valid_metrics = None

    print(f"Training for {num_epochs} epochs...")
    for epoch in range(num_epochs):
        model.train()

        batch_count = 0

        # Disable tqdm progress bar in training loop manually to ensure silence
        for imgs, labels in train_loader:
            optimizer.zero_grad()

            logits = model(imgs)

            # Multi-label BCE with logit conversion
            loss = criterion(logits, torch.tensor(labels, dtype=torch.float32)).sum()

            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()

            running_loss += loss.item()
            batch_count += 1

            # Manual counter instead of tqdm
            # print(f"\rEpoch {epoch+1}/{num_epochs}, Batch {batch_count}", end="")

        avg_loss = running_loss / batch_count

        # Validation
        model.eval()
        val_preds_list = []
        val_labels_list = []

        with torch.no_grad():
            for imgs, labels in val_loader:
                logits = model(imgs)
                proba = torch.sigmoid(logits)
                val_preds_list.append(proba.cpu().numpy())
                val_labels_list.append(labels.numpy())

        val_probs = np.concatenate(val_preds_list, axis=0)
        val_true_labels = np.concatenate(val_labels_list, axis=0)

        if mean_val_auc > best_val_loss:
            best_val_loss = mean_val_auc
            best_model_state = model.state_dict().copy()
            best_valid_metrics = val_aucs.copy()

        if (epoch + 1) % 5 == 0 or epoch == 0:
            # Silence stdout print if needed, but keeping it for feedback
            pass
            print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}: Val Mean AUC = {mean_val_auc:.4f}")

    # Save best model state if improved significantly (optional logic for better accuracy)
    if best_model_state:
        model.load_state_dict(best_model_state)
        print(
            f"Loaded best model state from Epoch {best_model_state.get('epochs', 'unknown')}"
        )

    # Generate test predictions
    print("Generating test predictions...")
    model.eval()
    test_preds_list = []

    with torch.no_grad():
        for imgs, labels in test_loader:
            logits = model(imgs)
            proba = torch.sigmoid(logits)
            test_preds_list.append(proba.cpu().numpy())

    test_probs = np.concatenate(test_preds_list, axis=0)

    # Ensure correct output shape
    if test_probs.shape[0] != len(test_df):
        print(
            f"Warning: Prediction count mismatch: {test_probs.shape[0]} vs {len(test_df)}"
        )

    # Prepare submission file
    # Use sample_submission template for headers
    sub_data = test_df[["image_id"]].copy()
    for col in class_names:
        sub_data[f"{col}"] = test_probs[:, class_names.index(col)]

    # Save to correct location
    os.makedirs("./submission/", exist_ok=True)
    sub_data.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
    print("Submission saved successfully to ./submission/submission.csv")

    # Final validation score report using Official Metric
    # Mean Column-Wise ROC AUC

    )

    elapsed_hours = (end_time - start_time) / 3600
    print(f"\nTotal execution time: {elapsed_hours:.2f} hours")
